regions.full_page: Thanksgiv .... Francis Bodey having had trouble with sist-like tumor in side of neck for 8 or 9 yrs. Enrolled last Thursday - Dec. 21st - in Ser. Masses, quite anxious at the time; comes To-day gratified that it broke next day and gave him great relief. Enrolls PP. Souls in Thanksgiving 5.00.

regions.full_page: Mrs. Marjorie Warren - 35 - and Family - Husband - Episcopelian - careless in regard to family for some time. - asks for divorce from lutherine wife. She enrolls the Family To-nite. 18th - No improvement so far in outlook; Mrs. advised to turn to Mary our Bl. Mother.

regions.full_page: Wm. Gillissie - 29 - shot down -Los Negros - when bombing the Japs. Plane was lost and two of the ten men; two more are still missing. But the other six after 33 days on a raft were saved - Parents re- ceived Telegram Nov. 18 that he was missing since Nov. Ist .- was Enrolled in Ser. Masses Nov. 25th (or) ... Thank ... Enrolled again 5.

regions.full_page: Robert Hamilton - 44 - Enrolled last Wednesday expecting brain, tumor operation on Friday. Dr's who had X-rayed his head were astounded at finding no tumor atal. However, they now predict blindness to follow! Brain Dr. - Crawford in Ford Hospital - Eye Dr. - Dr. Whit- ney ... Patient still in Ford's.
